overview_description.description: Deepnote is building the best data science notebook for teams. In the notebook, users can connect their data, explore, and analyze it with real-time collaboration and version control. Users can easily share project links with team collaborators, or with end-users to present polished assets. All of this is done through a powerful, browser-based UI that runs in the cloud. We built Deepnote because data scientists don't work alone.

about_short_description.short_description: Deepnote is a collaborative data science notebook for teams that is shareable, Jupyter-compatible, and runs in the cloud.

product.name: Deepnote Notebooks
product.description: A cloud-based collaborative data science notebook compatible with Jupyter that supports Python, SQL, and R for data analysis and exploration.

product.name: Deepnote AI
product.description: An AI-powered assistant integrated into the notebook environment that helps generate, refactor, explain, and debug code using natural language prompts.

product.name: Data Apps and Dashboards
product.description: Tools within Deepnote to transform notebooks into interactive data applications and dashboards with customizable layouts and no-code visualizations.

product.name: Notebook Scheduling and API Deployment
product.description: Features to schedule notebook executions and deploy notebooks as APIs for production use and model serving.

product.name: Collaboration and Team Management
product.description: Cloud-based collaboration tools including real-time editing, commenting, version control, and access management for data teams.

product.name: Data Source Integrations
product.description: Built-in integrations with numerous databases, data warehouses, file storage, and collaboration tools for seamless data access.
